claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: claim unchanged. refs mirror line 252-257: 'The scheduler ensures that, for each resource type, the sum of the resource requests of the scheduled containers is less than the capacity of the node.' v1.34 docs (round 1 WebFetch): the scheduler refuses to place a Pod if the capacity check fails even when actual usage is low.

Round 3: claim and s4 now say 'a limit with no request, or a namespace default, becomes its request'. refs manage-resources-containers.md lines 62-64: '... mechanism has applied a default request for that resource, then Kubernetes copies the limit you specified and uses it as the requested value for the resource.' refs limit-range.md lines 49-50: 'the LimitRange admission controller applies default request and limit values for all Pods (and their containers) that do not set compute resource requirements.'

Round 2: unchanged. refs node-autoscaling.md: 'If there are Pods in a cluster that can't be scheduled on existing Nodes, new Nodes can be automatically added'; resource requests are the most common constraint and 'they don't directly take into account the real resource usage'; goal unattainable when 'reaching configured provisioning limits'.

cluster-cost.md lines 3-5: 'Tài liệu tính chi phí cluster bằng số node và giờ công, không bằng tiền'; lines 16-22: node-count rule, '4 CPU và 8 GiB allocatable (giả định)', '70% (giả định)', '2 ngày công một tháng, giả định'. Lesson s4 'counts cost in time, not money ... two figures with no price' matches lines 3-5.

Round 2: unchanged. cluster-cost.md lines 26-46 as claimed; in deploy/gitops/config-repo-kustomize/base only api.yaml sets cpu/memory requests (250m/256Mi). Lesson s2 now scopes the 500m/512Mi to that directory.

cluster-cost.md lines 53-64 figures as claimed (950m/1984Mi; 2670m/5248Mi fits one node). Traefik serves the Gateway: cluster-migration-plan.md line 26 'Địa chỉ Gateway | NodePort 30080 và 30443 của Traefik'; threat-model.md line 24 'chỉ Pod của Traefik tới được api và Payments' (row on bypassing the Gateway).

Round 2: unchanged. cluster-cost.md lines 66-83 as claimed; tempo.yml 'block_retention: 24h'; Program.cs 'GetValue("Telemetry:SampleRatio", 0.1)'; envs/production/api.yaml 'replicas: 3', no HPA in envs/production.

STAGE.md line 113: 'All clusters are kind clusters on Docker Desktop'; line 122: 'No metrics-server runs anywhere'; lines 126-127: '`donhang-staging` (one node, about 4 GB with Argo CD, the Git server, Keycloak and the backend)'. Round 3: s5 now reads 'staging is a kind cluster on your machine, like every cluster in the repository, and no metrics-server runs in any of them', which matches lines 113 and 122.

v1.34 docs (round 1): 'The CPU request typically defines a weighting'; if a container exceeds its memory request and the node runs short of memory, the Pod is likely evicted. refs node-pressure-eviction.md line 351: 'BestEffort or Burstable pods where the usage exceeds requests' are evicted first. Overpacking follows from claim 1 (scheduler counts requests only).

Round 2: unchanged. Labelled opinion in a trade-off table; each cell follows from claims 1, 2 and 9 and cluster-cost.md lines 68-70. No unconditional ranking.
Round 2: unchanged. Each recommendation in section 7 carries its condition; consistent with cluster-cost.md lines 71-76.

issues.text: New, in changed text. The added sentence says the Tempo lever 'saves disk, not nodes' in the repository, and the next sentence restates the file as 'the levers lower the node count' with no exception. Both are faithful to their sources (compose runs Tempo outside any cluster; cluster-cost.md line 112 'Các đòn bẩy giảm số node'), but read together they contradict each other on the fourth lever.
issues.quote: The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count, and that none reduces the fixed platform share
issues.fix: Write: "The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count (in the repository, all but the telemetry lever), and that none reduces the fixed platform share, except removing a cluster or an environment."

issues.quote: so in the repository this lever saves disk, not nodes. Choosing those numbers is left to `cost-per-shop.md`. The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count
issues.text: New, in changed text. Two sentences after I am told the telemetry lever saves disk, not nodes, I read that 'the levers lower the node count' with no exception. I stop and wonder whether the fourth lever counts or not. I can work out that the file speaks in general and the repo is a special case, but nothing says so.
issues.fix: In the last sentence, add '(in the repository, all but the telemetry lever)' after 'the levers lower the node count'.

issues.quote: Tempo is in neither sum above: it runs in the lab, not in a cluster
issues.text: New, in changed text. 'The lab' is never said in English prose; in the excerpt 'Lab không cài metrics-server' seems to mean the kind clusters themselves. So 'in the lab, not in a cluster' made me re-read: where does Tempo run, if the lab is the clusters? I only get 'outside any cluster' from the second half.
issues.fix: Replace 'it runs in the lab, not in a cluster' with 'it runs as a Compose service on your machine, not in any cluster'.
